risk: API key exposure if future UI code calls provider directly.
mitigation: Keep all provider calls server-side and never commit .env.

risk: Provider result URLs may expire before download.
mitigation: Download immediately on callback or poll success; persist local file paths.

risk: Generated assets may publish without human review if automation is extended carelessly.
mitigation: Add explicit review gate before remote publish.

risk: Provider naming ambiguity: Key.ai vs Kie.ai.
mitigation: Keep question open and isolate provider code behind adapter interface before adding more vendors.
